question: Under SNA 2008, how should Financial Intermediation Services Indirectly Measured (FISIM) be allocated between final and intermediate consumption?
options: A) Treated entirely as final consumption expenditure of households
B) Allocated among user sectors based on interest margin differentials
C) Deducted directly from Gross Operating Surplus
explanation: SNA 2008 requires FISIM to be partitioned and allocated among borrowing/depositing institutional sectors according to reference interest rate margins.
